notes.78v.1: *stecken* (78v.2) is unclear, perhaps a stitch or a blockage. *bibinella* is pimpinella, burnet saxifrage or salad burnet. 'hemere' taken as hellebore. *steinvarm*, 'stone fern', is probably polypody. *eboum* is probably ivy. *troufe*, 'drip', may be rheum, gout or stroke. 'giht' (79r.5) may be gout or convulsions. 'trinke iz' (78v.1) taken as the woman drinking it.

nodes.text: [Hyssop] is a good herb. If the unborn child dies in the woman, let her drink it
with warm water; then it comes away from her. It is good for the *stecken*
and also helps those whose stomach aches. *Bibinella* is good for all
troubles of the heart, if one boils it with vinegar and takes it so.
Gentian and hellebore boiled with vinegar are good for the raving mad.
*Steinvarm* eaten with bread is good for those whose flanks
ache. Celandine juice is good for dim eyes if it is mixed
with wine and with oil and with white ginger. Mugwort
is good for a loose tooth. It is good for a woman for this, when she gives birth:
bind it on her belly; she is delivered at once. Take it off quickly
so that the innards do not follow after. Mustard crushed with honey, mixed,
is good for skin that has broken out. Mint is good against the lust
of fornication. *Eboum* is good for the *troufe*, if he drinks the juice.
Smallage is good for angry people, and for those whose belly aches,
if he drinks it in the bath. Houseleek juice is good for one who hears
badly: drip it into his ear; mix it with chicken fat.
Galangal is of warm nature; it digests and loosens; it makes
the mouth smell very sweet, and brings the man and the
woman to great love. Zedoary is likewise warm, so that it strengthens
the stomach for eating, and it is good against the bite of venomous snakes.
It is good for women. Ginger is also of warm nature;
it is good even for old women and old people. It drives away all the sickness;
it is also good for toothache. Pellitory is good for catarrh;
it drives that away, and other sickness of the mouth and of the throat.
Nutmeg is of warm nature; it strengthens a person,
makes kissing sweet; it is good for sickness of the liver and of the spleen.
Peony is good for bringing out in women their natural blood; it forces [it],
and is good for gout and for swelling of the body. Liquorice
is good for cough and for pain in the chest.
